title.zh: 从微观规则到涌现
title.en: From microscopic rules to emergence

title.zh: 冷却液体直到结晶，再把它熔化
title.en: Cool a liquid until it crystallises, then melt it

hint.zh: 粒子之间只有一条两体势；看有序是怎么自己长出来、又怎么消失的
hint.en: Only a pair potential acts between the particles; watch order appear by itself, then vanish

title.zh: 把时间倒过来：晶体熔化，再自己拼回去
title.en: Run time backwards: a crystal melts, then reassembles itself

hint.zh: 把所有速度反号，熔化的晶体一步不差地退回原样
hint.en: Flip every velocity and the melted crystal retraces its path exactly

title.zh: 粒子在管道里流成抛物线
title.en: Particles in a pipe settle into a parabola

hint.zh: 没有人写过流体方程；流速剖面由粒子碰撞自己长成抛物线
hint.en: Nobody wrote a fluid equation; collisions alone shape the velocity profile into a parabola

title.zh: 三维里的管道流：同一条抛物线
title.en: Channel flow in 3D: the same parabola

hint.zh: 五万多个粒子夹在两面热壁之间，加一个小力，流速剖面自己长成抛物线
hint.en: 55,000 particles between two thermal walls; add a small force and the velocity profile grows into a parabola

title.zh: 流过一个圆盘：背后出现回流
title.en: Flow past a disc: backflow appears behind it

hint.zh: 十一万个粒子流过圆盘，看背风面的流体怎么倒着走
hint.en: 110,000 particles flow past a disc; watch the fluid behind it run backwards

title.zh: 圆盘后面的尾迹有没有周期
title.en: Does the wake behind the disc have a period

hint.zh: 在尾迹里放一个探测区，量它左右摆动的频率（要跑几分钟）
hint.en: A probe in the wake measures how often it swings from side to side (takes a few minutes)

title.zh: 从下面加热：对流卷
title.en: Heat from below: convection rolls

hint.zh: 下壁热、上壁冷，把重力加大，气体自己分成一对对的卷
hint.en: Hot wall below, cold above: turn gravity up and the gas sorts itself into pairs of rolls

title.zh: 对流从多强的重力开始
title.en: How strong must gravity be for convection to start

hint.zh: 重力分六档往上加，看对流强度在哪一档离开热噪声
hint.en: Gravity rises in six steps; see at which one the convection measure leaves the thermal noise

title.zh: 敲一下，量声速
title.en: Tap it and measure the speed of sound

hint.zh: 推一下气体，看驻波来回摆，再和由粒子数据算出的声速比
hint.en: Push the gas, watch the standing wave swing, and compare with the sound speed computed from the particles

title.zh: 让机器从粒子数据里发现扩散方程
title.en: Let the machine find the diffusion equation in particle data

hint.zh: 两种粒子慢慢混合；程序从浓度的记录里拟合出它服从的方程
hint.en: Two species slowly mix; the program fits the equation they obey from the recorded concentration

title.zh: 同一条势，换一个维度
title.en: The same potential in another dimension

hint.zh: 同一条两体势，从二维换到三维，压强和结构跟着变
hint.en: The same pair potential, moved from 2D to 3D: pressure and structure change with it

title.zh: 三维过冷液体：等一个晶核
title.en: A supercooled 3D liquid: waiting for one nucleus

hint.zh: 把三维液体冷到凝固点以下，等晶体从某一处长出来
hint.en: Cool a 3D liquid below freezing and wait for the crystal to start somewhere

title.zh: 三维的一团粒子
title.en: A cloud of particles in 3D

hint.zh: 不带引导的三维分子动力学；可以暂停和重置
hint.en: Unguided 3D molecular dynamics; pause and reset as you like

title.zh: 两种互相不喜欢的粒子自己分开
title.en: Two species that dislike each other separate by themselves

hint.zh: 同种粒子相吸、异种粒子吸得弱，看混在一起的两种颜色怎么分成块
hint.en: Like attracts like more than unlike; watch two mixed colours sort into patches

title.zh: 一头亲水一头疏水的分子自己聚成小团
title.en: Molecules with a water-loving head and water-hating tails gather into small clusters

hint.zh: 高温时各走各的；降温后尾朝里、头朝外聚成十来个分子的小团
hint.en: Hot, they wander alone; cooled, they gather into clusters of about ten with tails inside and heads outside

title.zh: 同一个模型，同一个温度，换一个维度
title.en: The same model at the same temperature in another dimension

hint.zh: 同一个温度，二维的自旋是乱的，三维的排整齐了
hint.en: At one temperature the 2D spins are disordered while the 3D ones line up

title.zh: 把 Ising 晶格淬火穿过临界温度
title.en: Quench an Ising lattice through the critical temperature

hint.zh: 突然降温，看畴怎么长大
hint.en: Cool it suddenly and watch the domains grow

title.zh: 停在临界点上的 Ising 晶格
title.en: An Ising lattice held at its critical point

hint.zh: 临界温度下各种大小的团块同时存在；旁边是逐级粗粒化后的样子
hint.en: At the critical temperature clusters of every size coexist; beside it, the lattice coarse-grained level by level

title.zh: 三维 Ising 模型的一个切片
title.en: A slice through the 3D Ising model

hint.zh: 三维晶格停在它自己的临界温度附近，显示其中一层
hint.en: A 3D lattice near its own critical temperature, showing one layer of it

title.zh: 多一种状态，相变就换一种：连续的变成不连续的
title.en: More states, a different transition: continuous turns discontinuous

hint.zh: 三种状态时两种出发点到同一个能量；八种状态时停在两个能量上，差的就是潜热
hint.en: With three states both starts reach one energy; with eight they settle at two, a latent heat apart

title.zh: 停在相变点上的三态 Potts 模型
title.en: A three-state Potts model held at its transition

hint.zh: 三种颜色的团块，各种大小都有；旁边是逐级粗粒化后的样子
hint.en: Patches of three colours at every size; beside it, the lattice coarse-grained level by level

title.zh: 一团静止的天体坍缩，然后自己找到平衡
title.en: A cloud of bodies at rest collapses, then finds its own balance

hint.zh: 只有引力；看它怎么自己稳下来
hint.en: Gravity only; watch it settle by itself

title.zh: 四千个天体，只有引力
title.en: Four thousand bodies under gravity alone

hint.zh: 不带引导的引力 N 体；可以暂停和重置
hint.en: Unguided gravitational N-body; pause and reset as you like

title.zh: 几乎均匀的物质自己长出丝和团块
title.en: Nearly uniform matter grows filaments and clumps by itself

hint.zh: 二十六万个粒子只有引力，从 3% 的涨落出发；把显示切到“中间的薄片”
hint.en: 260,000 particles under gravity alone, starting from 3% fluctuations; switch the display to the middle slab

title.zh: 一个密度波自己塌成一张薄片
title.en: A density wave collapses into a sheet by itself

hint.zh: 幅度按 e^{γt} 增长，塌缩的时刻可以事先算出来
hint.en: The amplitude grows as e^{γt}, and the moment of collapse can be computed in advance
